title: rubus asper var. myriadenus
intro: Rubus asper var. myriadenus, commonly known as the thorny raspberry or wild thimbleberry, is a species of flowering plant in the rose family (Rosaceae). It is a type of raspberry that is known for its edible fruit and medicinal properties. The health benefits of Rubus asper var. myriadenus include its antioxidant and anti-inflammatory properties, which may help to reduce the risk of chronic diseases such as cancer and heart disease. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and anthocyanins, which may contribute to its therapeutic actions of anti-diarrheal, anti-cancer, and cardiovascular protection.
